upsert.funding: Initial evaluation and pre-enrollment diagnostics are owner-paid. Once enrolled, all trial-associated tests and treatments are covered, including CMP-002 (and PD-1 blockade if applicable), immediate hospitalization, study bloodwork and tumor biopsies. Trial-related complications are covered. One-week bloodwork at MSU is covered; outside bloodwork can be reimbursed up to $99. Surgery is not covered.

T-cell confirmation testing performed at MSU is reimbursed as an account credit after trial completion/progression. Trial recheck exams are free. The first dose of doxorubicin (CHOP) or lomustine (LOPP), including first-dose administration and bloodwork fees, is covered. Remaining treatment and bloodwork costs are owner-paid.

Up to 50% of surgical fees and histopathology fees are covered. Trial-specific medications (prednisone, diphenhydramine and famotidine/omeprazole) are covered once enrolled. Additional surgery performed during the same anesthetic event remains owner-paid.

Owner is responsible for diagnosis needed to qualify. Once enrolled, the study covers participation costs including blood and urine tests, flow cytometry, CT scans, chest X-rays, radiation planning CT, radiation therapy, TriKE immunotherapy and follow-up exams. Initial staging is also covered if performed at the University of Minnesota Veterinary Medical Center.

Qualified dogs receive a $4,000 credit toward local therapy (surgery or radiation) performed at the University of Minnesota Veterinary Medical Center. Owners pay any local-therapy cost above the credit. Other study-associated visit costs are covered.

Hospitalization and all study procedures, including CED treatment and follow-up MRI scans, are covered. Owner pays the initial MRI used for presumptive diagnosis, travel/lodging, ongoing medications and treatment of seizures or other non-study care.
$1,000 study incentive applied toward costs of other treatment or monitoring for enrolled dogs.
$2,500 study incentive applied toward costs of other treatment or monitoring for enrolled dogs.

No explicit current public breakdown of study-covered versus owner-paid costs was found on the current OVC listing. Confirm directly with OVC Clinical Trials; do not display a funded badge until a primary source states the coverage.
